items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Roy got the band together. We got a fellow by the name of Pep Wallace on bass, Roy Palmer on trombone, myself on conant... Seven pieces.

ctx.x: What part of town did you...

That was 6th and Rampart, Rounds, that's where I stayed after most of my time, and after that I grew up, and after I got up in age, I was 17 years old, and I went in business. I opened in New Orleans Ice Cream Paula at 6th and Rampart across from Bazee's Saloon, see. And I was on Rampart Street, two-story building, and Bazeele was right on the corner. Well, after I stayed there a little while, I made such a good business there, until Roy Palmer got in connection with me. And I told him, I said, well, I don't know…
